name: pmcro
description: Consolidated PMCR-O lifecycle plugin: 5 persona agents (orchestrator, planner, maker, checker, reflector) plus 5 command skills. Merges the former pmcro-orchestrator, pmcro-planner, pmcro-maker, pmcro-checker, pmcro-reflector plugins into one package.

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Open a trail cycle for a seed intent, route to a Chief for domain scope when applicable, and dispatch to Planner.

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Produce a PlanFrame from an Orchestrator-opened cycle, grounded in validated/dated resources.

skills.name: make
skills.description: Execute one approved PlanFrame step at a time and emit execution evidence.

skills.name: check
skills.description: Independently validate MakeStep evidence against PlanFrame success criteria and emit a PASS/FAIL CheckFrame.

skills.name: reflect
skills.description: Record disposition, promote Earned Constraints, optionally produce the next seed intent, and seal the trail.

notes: All paths are repository-relative. No absolute paths.
Governed by L-EVIDENCE, L-ORCHESTRATION, L-CHECKER-GATE, L-PLUGIN-ISOLATION, L-OUTPUT-CONTRACT.
